fullDescription: A high-density, professional SaaS dashboard designed for marketplace and auction platforms. The style features a 'Functional Minimalist' aesthetic with a focus on data clarity, using a primary corporate blue (#0066FF) against a clean neutral background (#F8FAFC). Key layout patterns include a 220px fixed sidebar, a 4-column responsive filter grid, and a complex data table with status indicators. Ideal for fintech, real estate listings, asset management, and B2B procurement systems requiring high information density and precise visual hierarchy.

structured.summary: A clean, data-rich auction platform UI featuring a persistent top navigation, a narrow functional sidebar, and a central workspace containing advanced search filters, a map-based discovery widget, and a comprehensive data table with rich list items.

style.description: The design uses the Inter font family for high legibility across small sizes. The palette is dominated by a primary blue (#0066FF) for actions and branding, supported by a sophisticated gray scale ranging from #111827 (titles) to #F8FAFC (body background). Micro-interactions include subtle hover states on cards and table rows, while components utilize a small 4px to 8px border-radius for a precise, professional look. Statuses are indicated by soft pastel backgrounds with high-contrast text (e.g., emerald, amber, and indigo).
style.prompt: Create a design system using the Inter font family. Primary brand color: #0066FF (Main), #0052cc (Hover), #E0EDFF (Light). Background: #F8FAFC. Surface: #FFFFFF. Borders: #E5E7EB. Text: #111827 (Heading), #4B5563 (Body), #9CA3AF (Muted). Layout spacing should follow a tight 4px grid system. Components: 4px-8px border-radius. Shadows: 'shadow-sm' (0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)). Transitions: 200ms ease-in-out. Typography hierarchy: Titles 20px/700, Section Headers 15px/700, Body Text 13px/400, Secondary/Label Text 11px/500, Tiny/Tag Text 10px/600.

layout_and_structure.description: A structured 1600px max-width container with a two-column sidebar/main layout. The main content is divided vertically into specialized zones for filtering, quick navigation (map/categories), and data results.

prompts.prompt: Height: 56px. Background: #FFFFFF. Border-bottom: 1px solid #E5E7EB. Left: 28px logo icon followed by vertical text logo 'НИС'. Center-left: Horizontal nav list with 13px text and 20px gap. Active item has #0066FF 2px bottom border. Right: 280px search input with #F3F4F6 background and left search icon, followed by notification bell with active dot and a 'Log In' button with #0066FF border.

Width: 220px. Spacing: 32px vertical gaps between sections. Sections: 1. Personal Account block with a primary blue CTA button. 2. Services list with 18px Lucide icons and 12px vertical spacing. 3. Support block with free-phone number highlighted. 4. Statistics panel showing key-value pairs (e.g., 'Active bids: 106,204') in 12px text. 5. Vertical promo banner with primary blue icon and bold 11px uppercase text.

Container: #FFFFFF, 1px border #F3F4F6, 12px padding. Layout: 4 equal columns. Inputs: 36px height, 13px text, 1px solid #E5E7EB. Types: Keyword search with icon, custom dropdowns with chevron icons, date range pickers (input-dash-input), and a 3-part toggle button group (All/Auction/Contest). Footer: Row with 'Additional Filters' (blue link with counter badge) and right-aligned 'Reset' link + 'Search' primary button.

Layout: 2-column grid (7:5 ratio). Left: Map widget with #EBF4FF dot pattern background, zoom controls (+/-/center), and circular #0066FF markers with count numbers and small labels. Right: Category grid (3x2). Cards: Square aspect ratio, thin border, centered 28px icon, 11px bold title, 10px muted count. Cards scale 1.05x on hover.

Header: Title (20px bold) + Result count, sorting dropdown, and view toggle (List/Grid). Table structure: 12px padding per cell. Column 1 (48px): Checkbox + Star icon. Column 2 (32%): 64x48px image + 13px bold title + 11px address + Category tag. Column 3/4: Detailed entity info with INN numbers. Column 5: Price (14px bold) + Tax info. Column 8: Status pill (Pastel BG, high contrast text). Column 9: View icon and vertical ellipsis.

special_ui_components.description: Compact color-coded indicators for lifecycle status
special_ui_components.prompt: Padding: 4px 8px. Font-size: 10px. Weight: 600. Border-radius: 4px. Emerald Variant (Active): BG #ECFDF5, Text #059669. Amber Variant (Pending): BG #FFFBEB, Text #D97706. Indigo Variant (Special): BG #EEF2FF, Text #4F46E5. Blue Variant (Category): BG #EFF6FF, Text #2563EB.

Background: #FFFFFF. Border: 1px solid #F3F4F6. Hover: Border #0066FF, shadow-sm. Elements: Lucide icon (28px, #3b82f6), Title (11px, #111827), Count (10px, #9CA3AF). Layout: Flex-column center-aligned.
